concept.title: NC State Cybersecurity
concept.shortdesc: This resource provides cybersecurity documentation and instructions to support members of the NC State community, including staff, faculty and students.

conbody.p: This resource outlines common cybersecurity topics and best practices for staff, faculty and students. NC State users can navigate this guide to find documentation and instructions for completing cybersecurity tasks, explanations of important cybersecurity concepts and to reference information about university resources.
Topics covered in this guide include:

ul.li: Endpoint Security: Protect your devices and systems from cybersecurity threats.
Network Connectivity: Connect securely to NC State wireless networks.
VPN: Install and connect to the NC State VPN.
Phishing: Recognize and report phishing attempts.
Email: Identify suspicious emails and verify email authenticity.
File Sharing: Share files securely and manage access in Google Drive.
Password: Create, maintain and reset university passwords.
Two-Factor Authentication: Manage authentication methods and devices.
Software Licensing: Navigate software approval processes and clickwrap agreements.
Public Devices: Protect your personal information when using shared devices.
Data Protection: Manage and protect sensitive university data.
AntiMalware: Protect your devices from viruses and other malicious software.
